result.summary: Wikipedia — Ada Lovelace: Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace, was an English mathematician and writer, chiefly known for her work on Charles Babbage's proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, the Analytical Engine. She published the first algorithm intended to be carried out by such a machine in 1843.
